preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer representing the number of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(len(C) == N and all(c in 'RGB' for c in C) for C, N in zip(C_list, N_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, C is a string of length N containing only 'R', 'G', or 'B'.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 and all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges) for edges, N in zip(edges_list, N_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, there are exactly N-1 edges connecting distinct vertices within the range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(is_tree(N, edges) for N, edges in zip(N_list, edges_list))
preconditions.description: The edges for each test case form a valid tree structure.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().lower() in ['yes', 'no'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a case-insensitive 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((is_valid(N, C, edges) and line.strip().lower() == 'yes') or (not is_valid(N, C, edges) and line.strip().lower() == 'no') for line, N, C, edges in zip(stdout_lines, N_list, C_list, edges_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Yes' if and only if for every pair of distinct Blue vertices (u, v), the simple path between them contains at least one Red vertex and at least one Green vertex; otherwise, the output is 'No'.
